Coram : HIMA KOHLI, AHSANUDDIN AMANULLAH
Issue for Consideration Whether the appellant is entitled to additional compensation for the left out portion of land at least @ 5% of the value of the award for a period spreading over 84 months. Headnotes Compensation – Additional compensation for the left out portion of land – – Appellant claimed payments towards delay of 84 months – Correctness: Held: Respondents had acquired a land by Notifications issued u/s. 20(E)(1) of the Indian Railways Act, 1989 – An award was declared on 08.02.2010 in respect of land that respondent acquired – A parcel
Decision Date : 16-05-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6458/2024 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
